messages:
Maria: FYI — paging for a degraded embeddings lookup started ~08:22 UTC. A subset of Dedicated customers hit elevated 5xxs and timeouts for embed/lookup calls for ~28m. AJ picked it up and worked with SRE. Incident is resolved; preparing a consolidated customer follow-up and status page text. Want quick reviews before sending to the impacted account contacts.

AJ: Confirmed. Root cause was a regression in the new KV-cache eviction logic causing edge-case cache thrashing under bursty prefix workloads; led to I/O contention on the node and request queueing. Rolled back the eviction change at 08:47 UTC which returned tail latencies to normal. No data loss, no model weights affected.

incident-bot: Paging alert: embeddings-service-high-error-rate triggered at 08:22 UTC. Pager acknowledged by AJ at 08:24 UTC. Mitigation action: rollback eviction-optimizer v2 at 08:47 UTC. Service healthy at 08:50 UTC.

Kevin: Adding a short timeline for the RCA and customer note. Suggest we include exact impacted time window, what we changed, immediate mitigations, and near-term preventative actions. Also propose offering a service credit for the window.

Maria: Drafting the statuspage blurb below — please edit: 
"We experienced increased errors and timeouts for embedding lookups between 08:22 and 08:50 UTC due to a cache eviction regression that increased disk I/O and request queuing on a subset of Dedicated nodes. We rolled back the change and verified service health. No customer data was lost. We are performing a post-incident analysis and will follow up with impacted customers with an RCA and preventative steps."

Zuri: Friendly reminder — when we send to the customer, use plain language and avoid infra jargon. They care about: 1) Was their data affected? 2) Is this likely to recur? 3) What compensation? 4) Who can they contact.

Maria: Agreed. Initial customer email draft (please keep short):
"Hi <Customer Contact>,

We wanted to let you know about a service disruption that affected embedding lookups for some requests between 08:22 and 08:50 UTC today. Your data was not modified or lost. The root cause was a recent cache eviction change that performed poorly under a specific workload pattern. We reverted the change and validated normal operation.

Next steps: we are completing an internal RCA and will share key findings and preventative actions by EOD tomorrow. As a gesture of goodwill we'll apply a billing credit for impacted requests; our CS team will calculate this and follow up in the next message. If you'd like a live review, we can set up a 30-minute call this week.

Apologies for the disruption — Maria (CS)
"

AJ: Minor edits: change "billing credit for impacted requests" -> "service credit equivalent to the estimated impact window"; add support contact line: "If you have urgent questions, contact support@redwood.com or reply and I'll escalate."

Maria: Updated. Kevin — can you confirm the technical accuracy for the customer-facing RCA bullets? We want to be transparent but not scary.

Kevin: Sure. Suggest adding a short bullet list after the first paragraph:
- What happened: a cache eviction optimizer caused (unexpected) thrashing under bursty prefixes, increasing local disk I/O and response queueing.
- What we did: rolled the change back, increased cache eviction timeouts on Dedicated pools, and rebalanced load.
- Impact: transient increased errors and latencies; some requests retried successfully; no persisted state changed.

Maria: Good. Also drafting internal comms template for AMs and ops (short):
"Affected customers: list linked. Summary: embeddings lookup errors 08:22–08:50 UTC, root cause, mitigation, customer outreach plan, next steps/RCA ETA. Action items: CS to notify customers and schedule calls, SRE to complete RCA, Eng to prepare permanent fix and test harness, Account Execs to review credits."

Zuri: For account exec outreach, please include a short TL;DR they can paste: "TL;DR: brief outage fixed in 28m, no data lost, RCA and credit coming. Happy to meet."

AJ: Follow-up action items I'm logging here:
- AJ: collect request logs and sample traces for impacted nodes (done, pushed to incident bucket)
- Kevin: run root-cause verification and test patch for eviction logic with synthetic bursty prefixes (in progress)
- Maria: validate impacted customer list and prepare credit calculations (in progress)
- Zuri: prepare AE outreach templates and coordinate offer/meeting cadence (pending)

incident-bot: Action logged to incident-1234. Postmortem due in 72 hours.

Maria: One question for Kevin — what's the expected ETA for a mitigation that prevents recurrence (not just rollback)? We need to tell customers whether this is a one-off or if we expect a patch timeline.

Kevin: Short-term: we can harden eviction thresholds and add guardrails in ~36 hours (testing + canary in staging). Long-term: a rework of the eviction algorithm with better burst handling — estimate ~3 weeks. We'll include both in the RCA: immediate mitigations and roadmap fix.

Maria: Perfect — I'll add that to the customer note: "We have an immediate mitigation being validated today and expect a permanent fix in the coming weeks."

Zuri: On credits — let's propose a 5% service credit for the invoice period overlapping the incident, subject to final calculation by Maria. If large enterprise we can be flexible.

AJ: One small timeline clarification request from Eng: when did retries start succeeding? Logs show some recovery attempts at 08:40 and majority success by 08:47 post-rollback. Can we match those numbers in the timeline?

Maria: Noted — final timeline in the customer note will be: "Errors observed 08:22–08:40 with partial recovery after mitigations; full rollback at 08:47 and service healthy by 08:50 UTC."

Kevin: Also add the operational verification: synthetic health checks and customer traffic sampling verified normal metrics by 08:52 UTC.

Maria: Final checklist before I hit send: 
- [ ] Confirm impacted customer list (Maria)
- [ ] Final credit calc and approval (Finance/CS)
- [ ] Tech accuracy check in RCA bullets (Kevin)
- [ ] AE outreach template (Zuri)
- [ ] Schedule optional post-incident customer call (CS/AE)

Zuri: I'll prep the AE note and have it in your inbox within an hour.

AJ: Thx. Please ping me before sending so I can add a short blurb to the internal incident channel about steps we took for mitigation/testing.

Maria: Thanks all — I'll send the customer email draft + statuspage update after Kevin confirms the RCA bullets and after I lock the credit number. Will post back here with the final sent copy. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident-1234 marked resolved by AJ at 08:50 UTC. Postmortem scheduled.
